picture-pairs.name: Pija me erũw
picture-pairs.seoTitle: Matching Game for Adults: Picture Pairs
picture-pairs.h1: Pija me Erũw: Geim in Kaimeroñ me Omwi
picture-pairs.description: A free, gentle matching game for adults and older adults, including people living with dementia. Pictures can stay showing. No timer or score.
picture-pairs.short: Metu pija me erũw me eñame. Pija ro kũ ba maña.
picture-pairs.intro: Tapun pija e, me e tapun pija me eñame bwe. Pija ro ba maña, bwe eab oboen me aea itũrũñ. Ña pija erũw eñame, eor raran goor ma mak in check.
howTo: Ñabwi ebaubwen pija me kom ogit bwi. Aia angō me 4 pija ebwaomwi bwe kom owaran.
Tapun gata pija. E tsimine raran goor.
Tapun pija me arin eñame. Pija me erũw ro eitũw ma mak in check.
Ña pija erũw eiyara, eab eor dudu me dogin. Tapun wagan ña kom memeg.
Katemoñ "Pija ro etuñ" ña kom erũw maro geim in aier ñwo.
tips: Ean iya pija ro me madaura iya: "Kapen ti me ebumoñ. Kom maro dairin iat ti um?"
Komaen amen kom aea bwe e tapun, arame e bwaran aea. Totowi me eab tapun bwe am kor.
Iyo pija 4 ña e omo am engame. Ebaubo pija e bwet am ñabwi, eab bwe kom eñame aen.
Aen ña e omo am engame. Geim ekaña e roñ me omo.

faq.q: E tsimine awa me skor?
faq.a: Eab. Eab eor kurok, skor, etan move me oten. Kom maro aen iat gata ao, me aen iat nũbwa e omo bwe roñ.

faq.q: Bwaran pija ro ro ba maña?
faq.a: Bwe pija ro ba maña, geim e eitũw aea ma kaimeroñ me eab oboen aea itũrũñ. Engame ro ebaubo aea e omwi. Kom maro kadudo pija ro etuñ iat tapun ekaña ña kom ogit.

faq.q: E mwiyen, me a oboen rejidur?
faq.a: Ee, e mwiyen, me eab eor akaunt, rejidur me download. E makur iat web browser iat fon, tablet me kompyuta.

faq.q: Kam maro aea pija in bwiema kor?
faq.a: Ee. Aea Photo pairs, me e komaen kom ñabwi pija ngen am devais. Pija ro ro ba iat browser me eab etu ngen internet.

find-the-same.name: Metu me eñame
find-the-same.seoTitle: Find the Same Picture: Simple Picture Game
find-the-same.description: One picture at the top, two to four below. Tap the one that is the same. A calm, free picture game for adults, older adults and families, with no timer.
find-the-same.short: Aea pija iat pouñ me tapun pija me eñame iat emwak.
find-the-same.intro: Pija ekaña e ba iat pouñ in skrin. Iat emwak e tsimine erũw, aiyiū me e aeañog pija. Tapun pija me eñame. E bwet ñabwi ekaña iat ao, me e tsimine ean me madaura.
howTo: Ñabwi erũw, aiyiū me e aeañog pija bwe kom ñabwi. Erũw e omwi kakarar.
Aea pija iat pouñ kom erũw.
Tapun pija me eñame iat emwak. E tsimine mak in check ma dorer in omo.
Ña e tapun pija me eiyara, geim e aen iya me e kikiñ. Eab kukur am ao.
Tapun "Pija nuka" ña kom memeg ñan pija epo.
tips: Madaura pija ro owaran kom ñabwi: kolor, anuan, iyat kom kũ aea.
Erũw ñabwi eab "ebarabwan". E bwet ao in omo, eab bwe kadur.
Ña tapun e mwejen, amen ro kũ totowi me kom tapun bwe am kor.

faq.q: E tsimine awa me skor?
faq.a: Eab. Eab eor kurok, skor, etan move me oten. Kom maro aen iat gata ao, me aen iat nũbwa e omo bwe roñ.

faq.q: Daga e bita ña e tapun pija me iyara?
faq.a: Eab eor dudu me dogin. Eab eor buzzer, raran cross me aeañeñ. Geim e aen iya pija me tapun me e kikiñ ñan tapun nuka.

faq.q: E mwiyen, me a oboen rejidur?
faq.a: Ee, e mwiyen, me eab eor akaunt, rejidur me download. E makur iat web browser iat fon, tablet me kompyuta.

shadow-match.name: Kaimeroñ anũan
shadow-match.seoTitle: Shadow Matching Game: Free Online for Adults
shadow-match.h1: Kaimeroñ Anũan: Geim in Pija me Omwi
shadow-match.description: A dark shadow at the top, two to four pictures below. Tap the picture that makes the shadow. A free, calm shadow matching game with no timer.
shadow-match.short: Aea anũan me tapun pija me e anũan e.
shadow-match.intro: Kaimeroñ anũan e aia makur me engame ro omaro iat peba, me ngago e ba iat pija ebaubo me eab ogit print. Anũan me omwi e ba iat pouñ in skrin me erũw, aiyiū me aeañog pija iat emwak. Tapun pija me e anũan e. Pija ro ngen baasiko, ambrera me kapen ti e omo iya madaura.
howTo: Ñabwi erũw, aiyiū me e aeañog pija bwe kom ñabwi. Erũw e omwi kakarar.
Aea anũan kom erũw. E bita arin? E ikũk me e momok?
Tapun pija me e anũan e. Iyin e ba iat emwak in anũan.
Ña e tapun pija me eiyara, geim e aen iya me e kikiñ. Eab kukur am ao.
Tapun "Anũan nuka" ña kom memeg ñan anũan epo.
tips: Towi reben anũan ma baim me madaura arin.
Ña anũan e mwejen ngago, kadudo ngen Metu me eñame, bwe pija ro ro eñame arin.
Madaura pija ña e metu: "Kam tsimine ambrera ngen ñwo omo."

faq.q: E tsimine awa me skor?
faq.a: Eab. Eab eor kurok, skor, etan move me oten. Kom maro aen iat gata ao, me aen iat nũbwa e omo bwe roñ.

faq.q: Can people living with dementia enjoy shadow matching?
faq.a: Many adults enjoy it, including some people living with dementia, often in the earlier stages. Shapes are easier to recognize than words. It is for enjoyment and conversation, not a test, and it does not treat or slow dementia. If it causes frustration, try Find the same or simply look at pictures together.

faq.q: Meda e gona ngago wo tepenia pija ngea e se bita?
faq.a: Eko meto e kowawa. Eko basa, koros e ebara me eko mwiwi. Gem e ougen egün pija ngea wo tepenia me e ropu bwo tep nanga.

faq.q: E firi ke, me a bo amin sain-ap?
faq.a: Eh, e firi, me eko akaun, sain-ap me daunlod. E makur ian web browser ian fon, tebret me kompiuta.

four-together.name: Four together
four-together.seoTitle: Picture Grouping Game for Adults: Four Together
four-together.h1: Four Together: a Calm Picture Grouping Game
four-together.description: Some of the pictures share a theme, such as fruit or weather. Tap the ones that go together. A free, calm grouping game with no timer and no score.
four-together.short: Find the pictures that go together, like fruit or weather.
four-together.intro: A small set of pictures, and some of them belong together: four kinds of fruit, perhaps, or four ways to travel. Tap the ones that share a theme. If a picture goes with something else, the game simply names it and waits. After a quiet pause a hint names the theme, and "Show the group" reveals the answer at any time.
howTo: Choose four, six or eight pictures. Four is the simplest, with three that go together.
Look at the pictures together and talk about what they have in common.
Tap each picture that belongs in the group. It gets a gold border and a check mark.
If a picture goes with something else, the game names it and waits. Take your time.
Tap "Show the group" whenever you like, then "Another set" for new pictures.
tips: Say what you notice out loud: "These two are both things to eat."
There is no rush. A hint naming the theme appears after a pause, and you can ignore it.
Talk about the group once it is found: a favorite fruit, a train journey, the weather today.

faq.q: Is there a timer or a score?
faq.a: No. There is no clock, score, move counter or losing. You can stop at any moment, and stopping halfway is a perfectly good way to finish.

faq.q: What happens if a picture from outside the group is tapped?
faq.a: Nothing unpleasant. There is no buzzer, red cross or shaking. The game names the picture, says it goes with something else, and waits for the next tap.

faq.q: What are the groups?
faq.a: Everyday themes that need no special knowledge: fruit, animals, flowers, weather, ways to travel, things for a hot drink and things baked in an oven. Each picture belongs to just one group.

faq.q: Is it free, and do I need to sign up?
faq.a: Yes, it is free, and there is no account, sign-up or download. It works in the web browser on a phone, tablet or computer.

odd-one-out.name: Odd one out
odd-one-out.seoTitle: Odd One Out Picture Game for Adults
odd-one-out.h1: Odd One Out: a Relaxed Picture Game
odd-one-out.description: Three or four pictures, and all but one share a theme, such as fruit or weather. Tap the one that does not belong. Free, calm, no timer and no score.
odd-one-out.short: Spot the picture that does not belong with the others.
odd-one-out.intro: Three or four pictures, and all but one go together: fruit, perhaps, or ways to travel. Tap the picture that does not belong. If a picture does go with the others, the game simply says so and waits. After a quiet pause a hint names what the others share, and "Show me" points out the odd one at any time.
howTo: Choose three or four pictures. Three is the simplest.
Look at the pictures together and talk about what most of them have in common.
Tap the picture that does not belong. It gets a gold border and a check mark.
If a picture goes with the others, the game says so and waits. Take your time.
Tap "Show me" whenever you like, then "Another set" for new pictures.
tips: Talk it through out loud: "The apple and the pear are both fruit. What about the bus?"
There is no rush. A hint naming the theme appears after a pause, and you can ignore it.
Any picture is a good start for a chat: a favorite fruit, a bus ride, a rainy day.

faq.q: Is there a timer or a score?
faq.a: No. There is no clock, score, move counter or losing. You can stop at any moment, and stopping halfway is a perfectly good way to finish.

faq.q: What happens if a picture that belongs is tapped?
faq.a: Nothing unpleasant. There is no buzzer, red cross or shaking. The game names the picture, says it goes with the others, and waits for the next tap.

faq.q: How is the odd picture chosen?
faq.a: The pictures come from everyday themes that need no special knowledge: fruit, animals, flowers, weather, ways to travel, things for a hot drink and things baked in an oven. Each picture belongs to just one theme, and the odd one always comes from a different theme.

faq.q: Ē ṉōmōn, ō ā ṉa ṉe eremer ni ṉōmōn?
faq.a: Yes, it is free, and there is no account, sign-up or download. It works in the web browser on a phone, tablet or computer.

color-match.name: Mātā kulōr
color-match.seoTitle: Mātā kulōr: ōgo ṉa ṉe ṉōn ṉa ōgo ṉa picture
color-match.h1: Mātā kulōr: Eremer ni ṉa picture ṉa kulōr ṉe ṉōn
color-match.description: A large color with its name, and four or six pictures. Tap every picture that is that color. No timer, no score, and another color is simply named. Free to play and print.
color-match.short: Find every picture that is the same color as the one shown.
color-match.players: 1 ō 2 tāwaru, ō ṉa adult ō ṉa child
color-match.intro: A large patch of color is shown with its name written beside it, and below it are four or six pictures. Tap every picture that is that color: a red apple and a red cup, for example. If a picture is another color, the game simply names it ("The pear is green.") and waits. "Show them" points out the pictures that match at any time, and "Another color" moves on.
howTo: Ṉōn four ō six picture. Four ē ṉa ṉa ṉōn ṉa simple.
Look at the color and read its name together.
Tap every picture that is that color. Each one gets a thick border and a check mark.
If a picture is another color, the game says what color it is and waits. Take your time.
Tap "Show them" whenever you like, then "Another color" for a new color.
tips: Say the color out loud, then look around the room: what else is that color?
Use your own words if you like. "Tomato" or "sky" is as good as "red" or "blue".
Pointing works as well as tapping. Sit side by side so you can both see the screen.

faq.q: Ē ṉōmōn timer ṉō score?
faq.a: No. There is no clock, score, move counter or losing. You can stop at any moment, and stopping halfway is a perfectly good way to finish.

faq.q: What happens if a picture of another color is tapped?
faq.a: Ṉōmōn ṉa unpleasant. Ē ṉōmōn buzzer, red cross ō shaking. Game ē ṉa ṉe picture ō kulōr ṉe ṉōn, ṉa “Ē pear ē kulōr ṉa grin.”, ō ē ṉa ṉōn ṉa tap ṉa ṉe.

faq.q: Ē kulōr ṉa clue ṉa ṉōn?
faq.a: No. The color is shown as a large patch and also written as a word, and every picture is named when it is tapped. Someone who finds a color hard to see can still play by reading the name.

faq.q: Ē picture ṉa kulōr ṉe ṉōn ṉa ṉōn?
faq.a: The pictures are chosen by hand, and only ones where the main object is plainly one color. Pictures with several colors, such as a kite or a bee, are left out.

faq.q: Ē ṉōmōn paper ṉa version?
faq.a: Yes. A one-page sheet has four rows. Each row names a color and shows four pictures to point to or circle.

faq.q: Ē tō ṉōmōn, ō ā ṉa ṉe eremer ni ṉōmōn?
faq.a: Yes, it is free, and there is no account, sign-up or download. It works in the web browser on a phone, tablet or computer.

halves-match.name: Mātā ṉa ṉōn
halves-match.seoTitle: Mātā ṉa ṉōn: ōgo ṉa ṉe ṉōn ṉa picture
halves-match.h1: Mātā ṉa ṉōn: Ṉōn ṉa ṉōn ṉa halves ṉa picture
halves-match.description: Left halves ṉa two ō three picture ṉa ṉe ṉōn ṉa side, ō right halves ṉa ṉe ṉōn ṉa side ṉa ṉōn. Tapōn half, ō ṉa half ṉa ṉe ṉōn ṉa fit. Ē ṉōmōn timer, ṉōmōn score, ō halves ṉa ṉōmōn fit ē ṉa separate. Ē ṉōmōn ō ṉa ṉōmōn ṉa print.
halves-match.short: Tap the two halves that fit together to make one picture.
halves-match.players: 1 ō 2 tāwaru, ō ṉa adult ō ṉa child
halves-match.intro: Each picture is cut down the middle. The left halves of two or three pictures are in one column and their right halves, in a different order, are in the other. Tap a half on the left, then tap the half on the right that fits it, such as the spout of a kettle and its handle. Halves that fit are joined into a whole picture. Halves that do not fit simply separate again, and the game says so gently. "Show me" joins them all.
howTo: Ṉōn two ō three picture. Two ē ṉa simple.
Look at the left halves together. What do you think each one is part of?
Tapōn half ṉa left, ō tapōn half ṉa right ṉa fit. Ē ṉa work ṉa ṉe ṉōn ṉa way ṉa round.
Halves that fit are joined, with a thick border and a check mark. Halves that do not fit separate again, and you can try another.
Tap "Show me" whenever you like, then "Another set" for new pictures.
tips: Trace ṉa edge ṉa half ṉa finger. Ā drawing ē ṉa reach ṉa middle?
Say what you can see: "That one has a handle." There is no need to name every picture.
Pointing works as well as tapping. Sit side by side so you can both see the screen.

faq.q: Ē ṉōmōn timer ṉō score?
faq.a: No. There is no clock, score, move counter or losing. You can stop at any moment, and stopping halfway is a perfectly good way to finish.

faq.q: Ā halves ṉa ṉōmōn fit, ē ṉa ṉe?
faq.a: Ṉōmōn ṉa unpleasant. Ē ṉōmōn buzzer, red cross ō shaking. Halves ṉa ṉe ṉōn ṉa separate ṉa ṉōn, ō game ē ṉa ṉe, “Ame ṉa two ē ṉōmōn fit ṉa ṉōn. Try ṉa ṉōn.” Ē ṉōmōn ṉa counted.

faq.q: Picture ṉa ṉe ṉōn ṉa distinguish ṉa ṉōn?
faq.a: Eng. Picture ṉe ṉōn ṉa hand, ō picture ṉa two ṉa board ē ṉōmōn ṉa same group, ṉa two fruit ṉō two animal. Picture ṉa halves ṉa ṉe ṉōn look alike, ṉa sun ō rainbow, ē ṉa left ṉa ṉōn.

faq.q: Ē ṉōmōn paper ṉa version?
faq.a: Ao. Ekai ruma mwin ni nem ko ekabwen ta ekangan reken ekaberau manga kiak: ekai ruma mwin ni nem ko ekabwen ta ekangan reken, a ekai ruma eniken ni nem ko ekabwen ta ekangan reken ekaberau mwin kiak. Kaberau nebe ekabwen ta ekangan reken ekai ruma mwin ni nem ko ekabwen ta ekangan reken ekaberau mwin ena me ebwen ekanga nakaian.

faq.q: E ekakairũ ko ni wan, ma e nen aorem kim ekairũ?
faq.a: Ao, e ekakairũ, ma kim aorem kaunen naoero, kim aorem ekairũ, ma kim download. E ekairũ ni web browser ko ni phone, tablet ma computer.

color-by-number.name: Kōlā ma namba
color-by-number.seoTitle: Kōlā ma namba: Kēm Ekaberau Ekairũ Ni Ekaberau Kōlā Kaberau
color-by-number.h1: Kōlā ma namba: Ekaberau ekaberau nebe ekaberau, kōlā nebe ekaberau ekairũ
color-by-number.description: Ekaberau ekai ruma tuber ekaberau nebe ekai namba, ma kin ekai kōlā 4 ma ekaberau ekai kin nea. Ekai kōlā, ma kin ekai ekaberau ekairũ ni ekaberau. Ekairũ kōlā kōlā ekaberau, kōlā rā ekai ekaberau, ma ekai button ekabwen ekaberau kin namba. Ekairũ ma print ko kaunen ekai kim.
color-by-number.short: Choose a color, then tap the numbered squares to fill them.
color-by-number.players: 1 ma 2 ekai naoero, ekaberau ekai ruma
color-by-number.intro: A square grid of large squares, each with a number, and a key above it with four colors, each with its number and its written name. Choose a color from the key, then tap squares to fill them. The grid is 4 by 4 to start, with 6 by 6 and 8 by 8 when you want more squares. When every square has the color of its number, the grid is the picture on the sheet. Squares filled with any other color are simply your own picture, and the game says nothing about it. "Fill with the numbers" fills every empty square for you.
howTo: Ekai ekaberau grid. 4 by 4 ekai ekaberau ekai ruma ekai ekai ekaberau.
Look at the key above the grid. Each color has a number and a name, such as 1 Yellow.
Tap a color in the key, then tap the squares you would like to fill with it.
Use the color on the number, or any color you like. Both are fine.
Tap "Fill with the numbers" for the empty squares, "Clear" to start the grid again, or "Another picture" for a different one.
tips: Sit side by side and take turns: one person chooses the color, the other taps the square.
Talk about the colors: "I like the green." There is no need to name what the picture will be.
On a narrow screen the 8 by 8 grid scrolls sideways inside its own box. The squares stay a comfortable size.
The paper version works as well with pencils at a bedside table.

faq.q: E ekai timer ko score ko?
faq.a: No. There is no clock, score, move counter or losing. You can stop at any moment, and stopping halfway is a perfectly good way to finish.

faq.q: Ma ekai kōlā ekai ekaberau ekai namba ko?
faq.a: Nothing happens, and that is the point. Any color can go in any square, and the game says nothing about it. When every square has the color of its number the game says so gently, and a picture in your own colors is just as good.

faq.q: Can the four colors be told apart by people with color-blindness?
faq.a: They were chosen to be. Every color also has a number, a written name and its own small shape, so color is never the only way to tell them apart. The four fills were checked with simulations of red-green and blue-yellow color blindness, and they also differ in lightness. A person with color blindness has not yet tried them, so please tell us if two look alike.

faq.q: E ekai ekai ruma ekai tremor ko screen tuber?
faq.a: Every square is at least 48 pixels across, and 56 on the 4 by 4 grid. If a grid is too wide for the screen, it scrolls sideways inside its own box rather than shrinking the squares.

faq.q: E ekai paper version ko?
faq.a: Yes. A one-page sheet has a numbered grid and the key of four colors with their names. Color each square with a pencil of the color on its number, or any color you like.

faq.q: E ekakairũ ko ni wan, ma e nen aorem kim ekairũ?
faq.a: Ao, e ekakairũ, ma kim aorem kaunen naoero, kim aorem ekairũ, ma kim download. E ekairũ ni web browser ko ni phone, tablet ma computer.

pattern-maker.name: Ekai pattern
pattern-maker.seoTitle: Pattern maker: Ekai tile ma print pattern
pattern-maker.h1: Pattern maker: Ekai tile, ma ekai ekaberau ekai repeat
pattern-maker.description: Ekai ekaberau ekai ruma tile tuber ma ekai pattern ekai ruma ekai repeat, ekai kōlā 4 nebe ekai name ma shape. Kim timer ko score. Ekairũ ma print ko kaunen ekai kim.
pattern-maker.short: Change the squares of a small tile and watch it repeat into a pattern.
pattern-maker.players: 1 ma 2 ekai naoero, ekaberau ekai ruma
pattern-maker.intro: A small tile of 3 by 3 squares, or 4 by 4 if you like, and beside it "your pattern": the same tile repeated in a block. Tap a square and it changes to the next of four colors, each with its own written name and shape. The pattern beside it changes at once. There is no right pattern and nothing is saved or sent. "Print my pattern" puts the repeated pattern on one page to keep, color in or give away.
howTo: Look at the tile and at your pattern beside it. They are the same tile, repeated.
Tap a square. It changes to the next color in the row of four colors above.
Keep tapping squares until the pattern looks the way you would like. Any pattern is a good one.
Tap "Surprise me" for a new tile, or "Start again" for a clear one. "Put it back" brings back the tile you had.
Tap "Print my pattern" if you would like it on paper, or tap Rest to stop.
tips: Ko ekaekaen ngan ko eman ko ebwe eppe: ekoa e tap ekwer ngan eman ekoa e ekaeki ne e akea.
Ko eban ngan tiap: "E ekaeki wa ekeni." Ko ekaeki ngan nai ekaeki.
Ko eppe ekwer ekoa ngan ekar kolor ruo, ngan ekar a ekaeki ngan kolor ewe.
Ewe pepa, e ebwe kolor ngan pensil, e ebwe ekaet ngan kaad, ko e ebwe ekaeki a kaad ni ekaroeng ekeke.

faq.q: E wa timā ngan kaunt?
faq.a: Aa. E aakea kilok, kaunt, ekwer ngan eman ko emaroe. Ko e ebwe tutu ekoa ne ekoa, ngan tutu ekoa e ekaeki ne ekoa ngan ekwer.

faq.q: E wa savi ngan sen ewe ekaeki ko kaeki?
faq.a: Aa. Ekwer ekar e tuo ni peij ekoa ne. E aakea savi, sen ngan kaunt, ngan e kaeki ne ko ebwe ekaeki. Ko e mwiij ekaeki pattern, ko ebwe print.

faq.q: E wa tap ekwer ekoa ne ekaeki ko ekaeki?
faq.a: E aakea ekwer ekoa ne. Tap ekwer ekoa ne ngan ko ebwe ekaeki kolor ewe. Ni "Start again" ko "Surprise me", "Put it back" e ebwe ekaeki ekwer ekoa ko ko ebwe mwaneng.

faq.q: E wa ekaeki kolor ekoa ngan eman ko e aakea kolor?
faq.a: E ekaeki ngan ekaeki. Kolor ewe e aakea ekar naem ekoa ngan naem ekoa ekar ekaeki ekwer ekoa, ngan kolor e aakea ekar ekaeki kanuo. Kolor ekoa e ekaeki ngan simulesen ko kolor-blaindnes. Eman ko kolor-blaindnes ekaeki, ko ebwe ekaeki ngan e ekaeki ekoa ko e ekwer.

faq.q: Ekwer ekoa e kebek ni eman ko e tremā ko skrīn ekeke?
faq.a: Ekwer ewe e ekaeki 56 pikseleb ekoa. Ni ekar ekeke e kebek ni skrīn, e ebwe rol ekaeki ni bokis ekoa ne, aa ebwe ekaeki ekwer.

faq.q: E wa ekaeki ngan pepa?
faq.a: E ekaeki. "Print my pattern" e ebwe print pattern ko ekaeki ni peij ekoa, ngan kolor ewe ngan naem ekoa, ekaeki ni black ngan white, ngan kolor ewe e ekar naem ekoa.

faq.q: E fri, ngan ko ebwe ekaeki ngan sain ap?
faq.a: E ekaeki, ngan e aakea akaonto, sain ap, ngan daunlod. E ekaeki ni web browser ni fon, teblet ko kompiuta.

drawing-duet.name: Drawing duet
drawing-duet.seoTitle: Drawing Duet: Eman Rua, Ekaeki Ekoa
drawing-duet.h1: Drawing Duet: Eman Rua, Shit Ekoa
drawing-duet.description: Eman rua e ekaeki line ekoa ni kanvas ekoa, ekoa ngan kolor naem. E aakea kaunt ko ebwe win, ngan ekaeki ko e ebwe savi ko print. E fri ekaeki, ngan aakea akaonto.
drawing-duet.short: Ekaeki ekaeki ekoa ngan eman ko e tu ngan ko.
drawing-duet.intro: Kanvas ekoa, eman rua. Ekoa ko ekoa ekar kolor, ngan kolor ewe e ekar naem ekoa. Ekoa ekaeki: ekaeki line ko shep ekoa, ngan ebwe pass pen. Ekoa e ebwe pass ekwer. E aakea pikjā ekoa ko skoa. Savi pikjā ni divaes ko, ko print pepa ekoa: shit ekoa, pen rua.
howTo: Ekoa ekar kolor. Banner e tiap whose turn, ngan kolor ewe ngan naem.
Ekaeki line ko shep ngan finga, maus ko pen. Ko ekaeki ngan arrow keys ngan Space ni aakea pointer.
Ni ko ekaeki, tap "Pass the pen". Ekoa e ebwe pass ekwer.
Tap "Take back my last line" ni tutu line ekoa ne eman ko turn.
Tap "Save picture" ni ekaeki file ni divaes ko, ko "Print the paper version" ni shit ekoa ngan pen rua.
tips: Ekoa tu ngan ekaeki ko e tok: "E ebwe ekaeki sun ni kona."
Ekaeki ngan dot, line ko shep ekoa, ngan ekoa e ebwe ekaeki.
Aa eman e ekaeki pikjā ekoa. Pattern ekoa line e kaoe ekaeki scene.
Ni ko ekaeki, tap "Done for now". Pikjā ko aakea savi ni ko ekaeki peij.

faq.q: E wa win ko kaunt?
faq.a: Aa. E aakea win, kaunt, ekwer, ngan kaunt turn. E aakea pikjā ekoa, ngan ekaeki aa e ekaeki ko ekaeki.

faq.q: E wa savi ko sen pikjā?
faq.a: Aa, aa ebwe sen ekoa. Pikjā e tu ni peij ekoa tok ko ko ekaeki. Ni ko tap Save picture, file e ebwe ekaeki ni divaes ko ko daunlod. Aa e upload.

faq.q: E wa tutu line?
faq.a: E ekaeki. "Take back my last line" e tutu line ekoa ne eman ko turn. "Start again" e clear shit, ngan "Put it back" e ekaeki line, ekoa wa ekaeki.

faq.q: E wa ekaeki aa maus ko touch screen?
faq.a: E ekaeki. Ni pikjā e focus, arrow keys e ekaeki pen dot, ngan Space key e ekaeki pen down ko up. Skrīn e tok "Pen down" ko "Pen up" ekoa ne ekoa.

faq.q: Kolor ewe e wa, ngan eman ko kolor-blaindnes e kebek ni ekaeki?
faq.a: Yellow, orange, green ngan purple, kolor ko ekaeki ni game ekoa ko. Kolor ekoa e ekar naem ekoa, ngan naem ewe e ekaeki ni turn. Kolor e ekaeki ngan simulesen ko kolor-vision, aa eman ko kolor-vision ekaeki aa ekaeki.

faq.q: E wa ekaeki ngan pepa?
faq.a: E ekaeki. "Print the paper version" e print shit ekoa ngan rules ni peij, ngan frem ekoa ekar ekaeki ko draw, ni eman rua ngan pen rua. E ekaeki ni black ngan white.

faq.q: E fri, ngan ko ebwe ekaeki ngan sain ap?
faq.a: Eee, a nan ang kaman ko, ao ikai na ekaun ni buk, ikai na ekaun akaiti, ikai na download. E rekareka ngaiñ te browser ni web ni telefon, tablet ko komputa.

build-together.name: Mauri ni kakai
build-together.seoTitle: Mauri ni kakai: Rua tangata, e tuai ngaiñ te bwakan
build-together.h1: Mauri ni kakai: Rua tangata, e tuai te grid
build-together.description: Rua tangata e kaboa n tabeua n akea ni buk ae ikai na imwi, n tiaki ni tuai ni kakai ni kakaokoa, kakaokoa ni kiritaki ma ni kanakanaba ae e bon ni toki ma e bon ni kariri. Ikai ngke ae e kamaiu, ikai te taim ma te kaboo. E ngaiñ kaboa ma kaiota ni maragarag.
build-together.short: Kabotaki ni tabeua ma te tangata ae e tu ngaiñ ni kakaoki te grid ae e tuai.
build-together.players: Rua tangata, e tu ngaiñ ngaiñ
build-together.intro: Te grid ae e tuai ni 4 x 4 nako, ke 3 x 3 ngke ko kakaonimakin. Ngkai tangitangi ae ko kaota ni kanakanaba, ma kanakanaba ake e rarau ana ataei ma kariri. Ko kabotaki: ngke ko kabotaki, ko kiritaki te akea ni tabeua ngaiñ ae e ko tuai ngaiñ kanakanaba ae e ko kaoti. Ngke e kaota te kanakanaba, te ataei e tuai ngaiñ mwakoro. Ikai tangitangi, n aon ikai te tangata ae e kamaiu, ma ikai ni kukuna ke ni kaota. "Print the grid" e kaota te grid ae e taeka ngaiñ te tabeua imwi ngaiñ, ba e kin tuai ngaiñ ni rua kaura.
howTo: Ngke kakaoki tangitangi ae ko kaota. Te kanakanaba ae e bon kaota te tangata ae e aon, e kakaota "E kaota".
Te tangata mwakoro e kabotaki mwakoro. Te screen e kaota ngke tei te kabotaki ao kanakanaba aei.
Kakaokoa te tabeua ae e tuai ni kaota ana kanakanaba. Te kabotaki e kaota ni tangata tabeua.
Ngke e tangitangi ni kaota kanakanaba, kakaokoa "Pass". E kakaota ngaiñ te tangata ni kabotaki n aon ngke ngkai.
Ngke e kaota te kanakanaba ao te tabeua, ko tuai ngaiñ te ataei mwakoro. Kakaokoa "Start again" ni tuai ngaiñ tabeua tabeua, ke kakaokoa Rest ni kateiaki.
tips: Ko tu ngaiñ ni kaota ke ko kaoti n aon te screen. Ko kabotaki ngke ko tuai: "I na kaota taku ni kanakanaba ni rawa ae ami."
Ko kaoti n tuai te maragarag, n tiaki, n te bwakan, ke ko kaoti kanakanaba n aon ngke ko kaotaki. Ueana e tika.
Te natiang ke te tangata ae e kakaraua ngke ko kakauareareana e rangi n tei n kaota n aon ngke e tangitangi. Ataei e tuai ngaiñ mwakoro.
N te pepa, tangata kakaokoa e kaota ni rua pensil ma e kaota te tabeua imwi ngke ko taua ngke e kaota.

faq.q: E tei te kanakanaba, te taim ke te kaota?
faq.a: Ikai. Ikai te kanakanaba, n aon ikai ni tuai te ataei mwakoro. Ikai te kaota, ikai te kaota ni kaota, ikai te kaota ni kanakanaba ke ni kabotaki. E kaotaki ngke ni mauri, ma te kaotaki ni tokiaki e tika ni kaota.

faq.q: E kaota ke e kaoti ngaiñ te ataei ae ko kaota?
faq.a: Ikai. Te grid e nako ni kaota ni boti aei ao. Ikai e kaota, ikai e kamaiu, ikai e koreia, ma e kaota ngke ko kaotaki te boti. Ngke ko kaonako ni kaota, kaota te grid ma ko tuai ni pepa.

faq.q: Ngke ko kaota kanakanaba ni akea ae e tika?
faq.a: Ikai akea ae e tika. Kakaokoa "Take back the last piece" ma te kabotaki e kaota ni mwakoro. Ko kaota ni mwakoro ni tibu ni tibu, ma e kaota ngaiñ te pass.

faq.q: E kaota ke e kin kakaokoa te kanakanaba ni rua tangata ae e kaota ni mataniwi?
faq.a: E kaota ni kaokoa. Kanakanaba ake e bon ni toki ma e bon ni kariri ao e bon ni tuai mwakoro, n aon ikai te kanakanaba ae e kaota ni kakaokoa. E kaota te kanakanaba ni kaota ni kaota ni rua ni mataniwi ni reboa ma te bwakan. Tangata ae e kaota ni mataniwi e ikai kaota ni kakaota, ma ko kaota ngke e rangi ao ko kaota ni tiaki ngke e riki ni tangata ni kanakanaba.

faq.q: E rangi te akea ni kaota ngke e tei te tabeua ke te screen ni kiai?
faq.a: Akea ake e bon ni 56 pixel. Ngke grid e kiai ni kaota ni screen, e kaota ngaiñ ni rarau ni kaota ngke e tuai ni kaota bwakan.

faq.q: E kaota te pepa?
faq.a: Ee. "Print the grid" e kaota te grid ae e taeka ngaiñ ni kanakanaba ma kanakanaba ake e bon ni toki, ni tuai ngaiñ ni rua pensil. E kaota ngaiñ ni kaota ae e bon ni tuai ni kanakanaba.

faq.q: E ngaiñ maragarag ao ko kaota ni tiaki?
faq.a: Ee, e ngaiñ maragarag, ikai ni akaunt, tiaki ke download. E rekareka ngaiñ te browser ni web ni telefon, tablet ko komputa.

seated-toss.name: Te tally ni tokaki ngaiñ te tu
seated-toss.seoTitle: Te tally ni tokaki ngaiñ te tu: Kaboa ni bean-bag ni rua tangata
seated-toss.h1: Te tally ni tokaki: Tokaki ngaiñ te tabeua, rua tangata
seated-toss.description: Rua tangata ae e tu ngaiñ te tabeua e kabotaki ni tokaki te bean bag ae e malu ni target ae e bon, ma e kateiaki te tally ni pepa. Ikai te taim ke te kaota. E ngaiñ kaboa ni maragarag.
seated-toss.short: Kabotaki ni tokaki bean bag ni target ae e bon, ma te tally ni pepa.
seated-toss.intro: Kaboa ni tokaki ae e kaboa ni rua tangata ae e tu n te tabeua. Ko kaota te target ae e taeka n te tabeua ma ko kabotaki ni tokaki te bean bag ae e malu, ke te sok ae e kokoro, n aon ni e tuai ngaiñ te rings. Tangata imwi e kateiaki te tally ni kakaota boxes n te pepa, ma ko kaota ngke ko kaotaki. Ikai te taim, ikai te kaota n te screen, ikai ni kaota ke ni koreia. Kakaota tau ni karikari ni safety: ai mwakoro e bon ni kakaraua.
howTo: Kaota ni karikari ni safety. Kakaokoa bag ae e tataki ni cover, ke kokoro ni sok ae e ririki.
Kakaokoa "Print the target and tally sheet" ma kaota te sheet ni tiaki n te tabeua imwi ngkoe.
Tu ngaiñ ni kakaota, rua ngkoe, ma kabotaki ni tokaki ni tokaki ni maragarag. Tangata e kaota ngke ni pass.
Ngke te tokaki e riki n te ring, kakaota te box n te kolam ami, n te rarau ae e aon te ring.
Ko kaota ngke ko kaotaki ni tally ngaiñ, ke kakaokoa Rest ni kateiaki.
tips: Sit close enough that a gentle underhand toss reaches the target without any stretching.
Talk about the toss, not the result: "That was a soft one." Everyone cheers for every toss.
A rolled-up sock is light and easy to hold with a weak grip. Rest an arm on the table between turns.
If someone would rather watch, they can be the one who ticks the boxes.

faq.q: Is there a timer or a score?
faq.a: No. There is no clock, score, move counter or losing. You can stop at any moment, and stopping halfway is a perfectly good way to finish.

faq.q: Is it safe to toss a bean bag?
faq.a: It can be, with care. Use a bag with a sewn-shut cover or a rolled-up sock, never loose beans, rice or small fillings, which are a choking hazard for young children and for anyone who puts things in their mouth. Stay seated, toss gently toward the table and never toward a face, and keep an adult close by.

faq.q: Is anything counted or saved on the screen?
faq.a: No. The tally is only on paper, in boxes you tick yourselves. The page keeps no count and no timer, and nothing is saved or sent.

faq.q: What if someone cannot toss, or the bag lands off the sheet?
faq.a: Anyone may pass, and a bag that lands off the sheet is simply picked up for the next turn. Nothing is counted for it.

faq.q: What is on the printed sheet?
faq.a: One page: a large target with its three rings named Near, Middle and Far, a table with a column for each person and a row of small boxes to tick for each ring, and a line of safety advice. The names are written on the rings, so it works in black and white.

faq.q: Is it free, and do I need to sign up?
faq.a: Yes, it is free, and there is no account, sign-up or download. It works in the web browser on a phone, tablet or computer.

seasonal-pack.name: Ngan ngan ngan ngan ngan ngan
seasonal-pack.seoTitle: Seasonal Puzzle Pack: Printable Paper Puzzles
seasonal-pack.h1: Seasonal Puzzle Pack: Three Paper Puzzles for Each Month
seasonal-pack.description: Three small printable puzzles for any month of the year: match the pairs, circle the one that is different, and color a picture in. The page opens on this month, or choose another, or take a rest day. Free to print.
seasonal-pack.short: Three printable puzzles for the month you choose, or a rest day.
seasonal-pack.players: All ages, solo or side by side
seasonal-pack.intro: Choose a month, and the page shows three small paper puzzles drawn from that month's pictures: two rows to join with lines, a row of four to circle the one that is different, and a picture to color in. The page opens on the current month of your device. You print one page, then do one, two or all three, at your own pace. Choose "Today is a rest day" instead and there is nothing to do.
howTo: Choose a month, or choose "Today is a rest day".
Look at the three puzzles, then tap "Print this month's pack".
Do one, two or all three, at your own pace.
Join the matching pictures with a line, circle the one that is different, and color the large picture in.
Stop whenever you like. A rest day is a good day too.
tips: Start with the puzzle that feels easiest today. One is enough.
Say the name of each picture aloud, if that helps.
Use crayons or pencils. Any colors are fine.
Keep the page for next time, or let it go.

faq.q: Is there a timer or a score?
faq.a: No. There is no clock, score, move counter or losing. You can stop at any moment, and stopping halfway is a perfectly good way to finish.

faq.q: Does the page know which season it is?
faq.a: No. You choose the season. The page does not look at the date or your location.

faq.q: Is there a score or a right answer?
faq.a: No. Nothing is timed, scored or checked on the screen, and no answers are shown. Each puzzle is only a picture to look at, join, circle or color.

faq.q: What if nobody wants puzzles today?
faq.a: Choose "Today is a rest day". The page then shows one calm line, and there is nothing to print or do.

faq.q: What is on the printed sheet?
faq.a: One page for the season you chose: its three puzzles, each with a short line of how to do it, and a line saying you can do one, two or all three.

faq.q: Is it free, and do I need to sign up?
faq.a: Yes, it is free, and there is no account, sign-up or download. It works in the web browser on a phone, tablet or computer.

decorate-a-card.name: Decorate a card together
decorate-a-card.seoTitle: Decorate a Card Together: a Printable Greeting Card
decorate-a-card.h1: Decorate a Card Together: Make One for Someone
decorate-a-card.description: Two people decorate a printed greeting card for a birthday, a thank you or just because, then write a message on the back together. Crayons or pens only. No timer or score. Free to print.
decorate-a-card.short: Decorate a printed greeting card together.
decorate-a-card.intro: A quiet making game for two people sitting side by side. You print one sheet, which folds in half to make a card. Choose an occasion, such as a birthday or a thank you, and decorate the front around its words. Then write a message on the back, together or one person writing what the other says. Use crayons, colored pencils or felt-tip pens. There is no right card, and nothing is timed, scored or sent.
howTo: Dir eberi ekaiakin, inan "Ioku karta" tap.
Ifi maa ibakan ikeer ni iram, koi iram ni kanim aon mwakan ni kakaiam ibwa ka enaano, ni iram na erema.
Tokin ena kakae ni kakaiam eaoa, ao tokin ena kakae ni bwai ni kanam, ke e raoraona ni kanam eaoa.
Kamaiaen ikeer n ia ni kairo tokin. Tokin ena kairo ao tokin ena kamaiaen ni kaituaki kanakan.
Kairo i aon manga kakaiam. Karta kakai ana kakai n ia enaano ana karta ni kaneaa kakairo.
tips: Kairo ioun kairo, inan ana tokin n kamaiaen, ao mwakan tokin ni kanam, ni ibakan ikeer.
Ngaio ena kake kanaan ni koa, e ko ngaio kakae ni kamaiaen ana kakaiam, ao ni kaituaki kakaiam.
Kakaiam eman ni taua ngaio, n tia ni anaana ni kamaiaen akanakan n tokin n ibwa ngaio.
Kamaiaen karta n iibwa n kakairo, ao ni koi koa n kakaiam kanakan ana tebu.

faq.q: E aoa ni kaneaa ao te kaubwa?
faq.a: Aok. E aoa kaubwa, e aoa ikeer, e aoa kakaiam ao e aoa kakaiam bwa e reirei. Ko kamaiaen ni kaituaki kanakan ni kaebwa, ao kaituaki ni mwakan ikeer e ngaio ana kairo nako.

faq.q: E kanakan ni kakai nakoi, ni kaeou ao kaboaboa?
faq.a: Aok. Ngaio kokoro, ngaio kakae ni kakaiam, ao nakoi kakaiam kakae e kana. E aoa kakaiam, koi ao kanakan ni kakai.

faq.q: E kakanakan ni kakae karta n ikeer ae e aoa ana tokin ni kairo?
faq.a: Kaiaki "Ao n tabeman" ao kakai ana kakaiam ikeer n ia karta, ao ni kakaiam karta bwa e aoa ikeer.

faq.q: Is anything counted, judged or saved on the screen?
faq.a: Aok. Website e kakaiam karta ao tokin wene. E aoa ikeer, e aoa kakaiam, e aoa kakairo, ao e aoa karta ni kakaiam eaoa.

faq.q: Are ana iram n tokin iram?
faq.a: Ikeer ana iram: karta ni koraki eka, ana ikeer ni kakai ana ikeer n ia ana karta ibwa, ao kakaiam ni kaituaki kanakan bon ikeer. Tokin n kamaiaen ao mwakan ikeer ni kaituaki kanakan bon ana iram.

faq.q: E kakanakan ao e kakaiam kakakae?
faq.a: Aok, e kakanakan, ao e aoa account, kakaiam ni kakairo ao iram. E kakairo ni web browser ni phone, tablet ao computer.

find-together.name: Find together
find-together.seoTitle: Find Together: Tokin Ikeer Ni Kakai Pairs
find-together.h1: Find Together: Tokin Ikeer, Ikeer Aon Team
find-together.description: Tokin ikeer ni kairo screen aon ao kakaiam kakai ikeer karta ni kaituaki kanakan ni kakai pair. Pairs e kakai ana tokin ni kakairo ao kakaiam ana tally aon. Kakanakan ni kakai, e aoa kaubwa ao e aoa ikeer.
find-together.short: Kakaiam ikeer ana tokin n ia ni kakai picture pairs.
find-together.intro: Karta ana kakai ni picture ni koraki, ao ngaio ni kakae ni kaiaki. Ana kakaiam ikeer, ko kaituaki karta ikeer. Ngke pair, kakai ni kakairo ao kakaiam eaoa. Ngke ikanakan, ikeer ni kakaiam ni tia "Kakai karta", bwa ko kakaiam. Kakaiam ana kairo. Tally ni ngaio e kakai n ikai: pairs ni kakairo ikeer.
howTo: Kaiaki tokin karta ni kairo. Ono karta, ono pairs, e kairo ao kakaiam.
Screen e kakai ana tokin ni kakaiam, aon circle ana tokin mwakan ao square ana tokin aon.
Kaituaki karta ikeer, ikeer ikeer. Ngke pair, kakai ikeer.
Ngke ikanakan, kaiaki "Kakai karta" ngke kanakan. Kakaiam e kakai.
Iai tokin e kakaiam "Pass" ao kaituaki. Kaiaki "Start again" bwa karta ni kanakan, ao Rest bwa kakaiam.
tips: Kakaiam ikeer, ao kakai picture ni kakae: "Te ngaio. Ko kamaiaen milk n tii?"
Kakaneaa tokin ao kakaiam tap, nakoi e kakae. Kakai ikeer ni kakae tap.
Kaiaki "Cards face down" ngke ikeer kaituaki kakaiam karta ni kakai picture.
Tokin e kakae ao kakaiam n kakaiam pass, ae kakairo ikeer ana pairs.

faq.q: E iai winner, timer ao score?
faq.a: Aok. E aoa winner, bwa kakai pairs ana team. E aoa kaubwa, e aoa score, e aoa kakae miss. Tally e kakai pairs ni kakairo ikeer, ao ko kakaiam ngaio.

faq.q: Ti kanakan ni kakae ae picture e tu?
faq.a: Aok. Kaubwa e kakai picture ni koraki. Ngke karta face down, ko kakaiam ana kakae, ke kairo karta ni kakaiam.

faq.q: E kakanakan ngke karta ni kakaiam?
faq.a: Ekai face up, bwa ko kakaiam, ao ni kanakan ngaio. E aoa kakaiam ikeer ana karta. Ngke kakaiam, kaiaki "Kakai karta" ao kakairo.

faq.q: E kakaiam ao e kakairo ngaio ti tokin?
faq.a: Aok. Karta e koraki page ni. E aoa kakaiam, kakairo ao kakaiam. E kakaiam ngke ko kakai page.

faq.q: Karta e kakanakan ni tremor ao screen kaboaboa?
faq.a: Karta ni kakai e 64 pixels ao kakaiam n kakanakan ni screen e kakaiam. Kakai keyboard ao screen reader e kakai karta ni kakae ana tokin ao picture.

faq.q: E kakanakan ao e kakaiam kakakae?
faq.a: Aok, e kakanakan, ao e aoa account, kakaiam ni kakairo ao iram. E kakairo ni web browser ni phone, tablet ao computer.

story-dice.name: Story dice
story-dice.seoTitle: Story Dice: Kakaiam Ikeer Ni Picture
story-dice.h1: Story Dice: Kakai Ikeer Ni Picture
story-dice.description: Dice picture tolu ao ha n kakai ikeer, ana kakaiam ikeer. E aoa kakae, e aoa answer ikeer, e aoa kaubwa ao score. Roll ikeer, ao ni pass. Kakanakan ao ni print.
story-dice.short: Roll dice picture ao kakai ikeer tokin ni ia kakaiam, ikeer ikeer.
story-dice.players: 2 tokin ao kakai, ao adult ao child
story-dice.intro: Três ou quatro imagens são mostradas, como dados. Juntos, criem uma história que as use, em qualquer ordem. Uma história pode ter uma frase ou algumas, pode ser engraçada ou pode ser do dia a dia. Não existe história certa, e ninguém precisa dar nome a nada nem lembrar de nada. Toque em "Rolar de novo" para novas imagens, e qualquer pessoa pode passar a vez.
howTo: Escolham três ou quatro dados. Três é o mais simples.
Olhem as imagens juntos. Toquem em uma se quiserem começar por ela.
Revezem-se contando uma história que use as imagens, em qualquer ordem. Uma frase de cada um já basta.
Qualquer pessoa pode passar a vez. Toque em "Passar" e a pessoa seguinte pode começar.
Toque em "Rolar de novo" para novas imagens sempre que quiser, ou toque em Descansar para parar.
tips: Faça uma pergunta em vez de esperar uma resposta: "Para onde será que o guarda-chuva estava indo?"
Acrescente ao que a pessoa anterior disse, em vez de corrigi-la. Qualquer história serve.
Uma história pode ser sobre uma lembrança real. Uma imagem é um bom começo para isso.

faq.q: Há cronômetro ou pontuação?
faq.a: Não. Não há relógio, pontuação, contador de jogadas nem derrota. Você pode parar a qualquer momento, e parar no meio também é uma boa forma de terminar.

faq.q: Preciso ler ou dar nome às imagens?
faq.a: Não. O jogo funciona só com as imagens. As pessoas podem apontar, descrever ou simplesmente dizer o que a imagem lembra. Ninguém é convidado a dar nome ou a lembrar de nada.

faq.q: E se alguém não quiser jogar a sua vez?
faq.a: Essa pessoa pode passar a vez a qualquer momento, sem precisar explicar. O jogo simplesmente espera, e a pessoa seguinte pode começar, ou vocês podem rolar de novo.

faq.q: Existe uma versão em papel?
faq.a: Sim. Uma folha de uma página tem dezesseis imagens diferentes em quatro linhas. Escolham uma linha, ou recortem as imagens e tirem algumas de um monte.

faq.q: É gratuito, e preciso me cadastrar?
faq.a: Sim, é gratuito, e não há conta, cadastro nem download. Funciona no navegador da internet, no celular, no tablet ou no computador.

word-and-picture-pairs.name: Pares de palavra e imagem
word-and-picture-pairs.seoTitle: Pares de palavra e imagem: combine palavras com figuras
word-and-picture-pairs.h1: Pares de palavra e imagem: combine a palavra com a figura
word-and-picture-pairs.description: Combine palavras em inglês com as suas imagens e ouça qualquer palavra em voz alta. As imagens ficam à vista, sem cronômetro, pontuação nem contagem de tentativas. Gratuito para jogar e imprimir.
word-and-picture-pairs.short: Combine cada palavra com a sua imagem e ouça-a em voz alta.
word-and-picture-pairs.players: Um adulto, ou uma família jogando lado a lado
word-and-picture-pairs.intro: São mostradas quatro ou seis imagens, com as suas palavras em inglês em outra ordem. Toque em uma palavra e depois na sua imagem, ou em uma imagem e depois na sua palavra. Um par combinado fica junto, com uma borda grossa e a palavra "Combinado". Toque em "Ler em voz alta" ao lado de qualquer palavra para ouvi-la. Nada é cronometrado nem pontuado, e um toque que não combina simplesmente se desfaz.
howTo: Escolham quatro ou seis imagens. Quatro é o mais simples.
Toque em uma palavra e depois na imagem que ela nomeia. Ou toque primeiro em uma imagem e depois na sua palavra.
Um par combinado fica junto. Um toque que não combina é desfeito em silêncio, então tentem outro.
Toque em "Ler em voz alta" ao lado de uma palavra para ouvi-la, se o seu aparelho puder ler textos em voz alta.
Toque em "Novas imagens" para outro conjunto, ou em "Recomeçar" para desfazer todos os pares. "Devolver" traz de volta as últimas combinações.
tips: Digam cada palavra em voz alta juntos antes de combiná-la, e conversem sobre a imagem.
As famílias podem revezar-se. Cada pessoa escolhe uma palavra ou uma imagem por vez.
Usem primeiro as palavras que já conhecem, e deixem as outras para depois.

faq.q: Há cronômetro ou pontuação?
faq.a: Não. Não há relógio, pontuação, contador de jogadas nem derrota. Você pode parar a qualquer momento, e parar no meio também é uma boa forma de terminar.

faq.q: Isto é para crianças?
faq.a: Foi feito para adultos que estão aprendendo ou reaprendendo palavras em inglês, e para famílias que jogam lado a lado. Não foi escrito para crianças.

faq.q: E se o meu aparelho não puder ler textos em voz alta?
faq.a: O botão Ler em voz alta usa a voz que o seu navegador já tem. Se o navegador não conseguir falar, o botão não aparece e o jogo funciona sem ele.

faq.q: Existe uma versão em papel?
faq.a: Sim. Uma folha de uma página tem seis imagens e suas seis palavras, para recortar ou para unir com uma linha.

faq.q: É gratuito, e preciso me cadastrar?
faq.a: Sim, é gratuito, e não há conta, cadastro nem download. Funciona no navegador da internet, no celular, no tablet ou no computador.

sort-together.name: Aetan ituga
sort-together.seoTitle: Jogo de separar: separe juntos para adultos
sort-together.h1: Sort Together: Makur in Aetan Pija
sort-together.description: Toque em uma imagem e depois na cesta a que ela pertence: cozinha ou jardim, fruta ou animal. Um jogo de separar calmo e gratuito para adultos e famílias.
sort-together.short: Aetan iturin pija ian eben ebwer: kisin me gadun, me meto nanga.
sort-together.intro: Aetan meto bita makur ngea e mwamweiy me roke iat eb, erier animwen aetan katen ian stua me aetan soks. Tepenia pija, me tepenia ebwer ngea e bwiida ian. Eko rupe me eko meto e se bita.
howTo: Ita theme: kisin me gadun, wuan eto me man, me mwenge me fofori.
Tepenia pija. E bwida an gold border.
Tepenia ebwer ngea e bwiida ian. Pija e nuwaw ian bita ebwer.
Ngago e bwiida ian bita ebwer nanga, gem e dorer ian omo me e ropu.
Ngago e modin aetan pija, aea ian eben ebwer ituga.
tips: Iat eb e tsimine bita eko wrong answer. Ngago amen omera e dorer bita watering can e bwiida ian kisin, kiowen dorer bwo meda. Wo kona orre karani dorer e omo.
Kukuni pija bwo dorer: "Meda wo aruma ian am gadun?"
Aetan meto iat eb, erier spun me fok me baten ian karor, bita makur e omo ngago wo eab aea skrin.

faq.q: E tsimine ke taima me skoa?
faq.a: Eab. Eko kurok, skoa, namban move me eko edae. Wo kona teki ian ga ean, me teki ian nukon e omo kor bwo amin modin.

faq.q: Bwo meda aetan?
faq.a: Engame e baji re maruwei aetan bwo erier makur e omo me re roke. E mwamweiy ngeni amin kakairũ bwo pija ngago wo makur.

faq.q: E firi ke, me a bo amin sain-ap?
faq.a: Eh, e firi, me eko akaun, sain-ap me daunlod. E makur ian web browser ian fon, tebret me kompiuta.

picture-puzzle.name: Pija pasro
picture-puzzle.seoTitle: Quebra-cabeça online fácil: 4 ou 9 peças grandes
picture-puzzle.description: Um quebra-cabeça online fácil para adultos: 4 ou 9 peças grandes, a imagem inteira fica à vista, e você toca em duas peças para trocá-las. Use a sua própria foto, que fica neste aparelho. Gratuito, sem cronômetro.
picture-puzzle.short: Tepenia aro piece bwo amin ibiwi me pija e bwiida.
picture-puzzle.intro: Uma imagem simpática é cortada em quatro ou nove peças grandes e embaralhada. A imagem inteira fica à vista como guia. Toque em uma peça e depois em outra, e elas trocam de lugar. Não é preciso arrastar. Você também pode usar uma das suas próprias fotos. Ela fica neste aparelho e nunca é enviada.
howTo: Ita pija me 4 me 9 pieces. 4 e omo bwo kererin.
Aea pija e modin ian pwon.
Tepenia piece, me tepenia eb ngea e bwiida ian. Aro piece re ibiwi.
Pieces ngago e bwiida ian eben re orre check mark e eowur.
Ngago pija e modin, maruwei ituga, me ita pija nanga.
tips: Tepenia aro piece bwo amin ibiwi e mwamweiy kor pumwe dragging bwo engame e baji.
Dorer bwo pija ngago e bwiida: "Ngea bita red roof."
Jigsaw in debao iat eb me 12 me 24 pieces e kowawa bita makur ian tebo e omo kor.

faq.q: E tsimine ke taima me skoa?
faq.a: Eab. Eko kurok, skoa, namban move me eko edae. Wo kona teki ian ga ean, me teki ian nukon e omo kor bwo amin modin.

faq.q: A bo ke amin drag pieces?
faq.a: Eab. Tepenia a piece, me tepenia nanga, me re ibiwi eben. E mwamweiy ngago e mwiwi be me ian skrin e eowur.

faq.q: E firi ke, me a bo amin sain-ap?
faq.a: Eh, e firi, me eko akaun, sain-ap me daunlod. E makur ian web browser ian fon, tebret me kompiuta.

finish-the-saying.name: Modin dorer
finish-the-saying.seoTitle: Complete o ditado: jogo de frases conhecidas
finish-the-saying.description: Dorerin eraro me ngago me Amerika ngago e mwaer dorer ian aeaen, erier "A penny saved is a penny ___". Tepenia dorer me aea bita modin, me dorer bwo meto nanga.
finish-the-saying.short: Kamodin dorerin eraro ituga, me kakairũ bwo meto nanga.
finish-the-saying.intro: Dorerin ngago re roke iat eb. Katen e aea dorerin eraro me dorer ian aeaen e mwaer, aiji choices, me baten in "Show the ending". Ngago e aea modin, dorer in kiowen e omo bwo amin kakairũ.
howTo: Aea dorer ian ituga.
Tepenia dorer ngea e kamodin, me tepenia "Show the ending".
Aea dorer e modin bwo amin kakairũ.
Tepenia "Next saying" ngago wo bo.
tips: Aea ian mwamwein me ropu iat dorer ian aeaen. Engame re dorer ngago wo eita modin.
Ngago amen omera e dorer modin nanga, maruwei. Dorerin eraro nanga e bwiida ian mwenge me eb nanga.
Ian koro engame, eman e aea me engame modin re dorer modin.

faq.q: E tsimine ke taima me skoa?
faq.a: Eab. Eke kurok, mak, an wounen nane me erum. O bwiida ian ngago me ngago, me an bwiida ian ubun e magitet an erieri.

faq.q: Me ekeita me da aen dorer me ijei?
faq.a: Aitsiu e aen ijei an erieri me e tsimor dorer. Eke mak, me iwonen an me ijei e omo.

faq.q: E maagur eij, me e magu a an tsiedida?
faq.a: Io, e maagur, me eke akaun, eke tsiedida me eke daunrood. E mwir ian web browser ian tepon, tablet me kompiuta.

word-search.name: Tsimor dorer iwonen etong
word-search.seoTitle: Caça-palavras em letra grande, gratuito e para imprimir
word-search.description: Um caça-palavras gratuito, com letra grande, para adultos mais velhos e famílias. Poucas palavras, letras grandes, apenas na horizontal e na vertical. Jogue online ou imprima.
word-search.short: Etong reta, eke ebwak dorer, rir me ebwio. Bwio ian bwapepa tsin.
word-search.intro: Grid ekeking me reta etong me eke ebwak dorer, rir me ebwio. Tsinita te reta an ebwa ian dorer, me tsinita an erieri reta. O gobweda bwapepa? Bwio eke aitsiu ian aiquen tsinita.
howTo: Aen tema me ekeida grid.
Aea list in dorer. Dorer e rir (meo ñan atag) me e ebwio (pwer me ijad).
Tsinita te reta an ebwa ian dorer, me tsinita an erieri reta.
Dorer ngago o arowa e kakar me e omar ian list.
Tsinita "Bwio aitsiu" bwe o tsimor ian bwapepa me pensir me maka.
tips: Doreda dorer ian list me irowida reta an ebwa nanga.
Ian bwapepa, highlighter e mwir an koro me pensir.
Dorer katsimor tema in dorer. Dorer in wani e katsimor aea in bwer, kok me maket.

faq.q: E tsimor kurok me mak?
faq.a: Eab. Eke kurok, mak, an wounen nane me erum. O bwiida ian ngago me ngago, me an bwiida ian ubun e magitet an erieri.

faq.q: A ngab bwio tsimor dorer?
faq.a: Io. Tsinita "Bwio aitsiu" bwe o bwio grid ian reta etong, me list in dorer e pwer. Tsimor dorer me eke tsimor e bwiida me ijei.

faq.q: E maagur eij, me e magu a an tsiedida?
faq.a: Io, e maagur, me eke akaun, eke tsiedida me eke daunrood. E mwir ian web browser ian tepon, tablet me kompiuta.

coloring.name: Bwapepa in kakar
coloring.seoTitle: Páginas para colorir para adultos, grandes e simples, gratuitas
coloring.description: Bwapepa in kakar ekeking ñan engame ririd me etong tsi: tsinita kala, me tsinita aitsiu. Eke buoita, eke kala me ijei, me aiquen bwapepa e maagur an bwio.
coloring.short: Tsinita kala, me tsinita aitsiu. Bwio bwapepa tsin.
coloring.intro: Bwapepa me etong tsi ekeking: dugidu ian pod, ebwa, tiikap, bepe me eangan. Tsinita kala, me tsinita aitsiu bwe o kakar. Eke kala me erum.
howTo: Aen bwapepa.
Tsinita kala. Aiquen kala e torea etam.
Tsinita aitsiu bwe o omodida me kala.
O mwir an wounen ngago me ngago ian an kakar ijei.
Tsinita "Bwio aitsiu" bwe o arowa bwapepa kakar me pensir me maka.
tips: Aean erogo kala bwe en aen me eke magitet aen amuro.
Dabugbug iwonen karoro me puji iwonen edag e omo. Aitsiu e katsimor kakar, me eke katsimor an bwiida.
Bwapepa ngago o bwio e omo me maka etong me crayons, bwe e mwir an koro.

faq.q: E tsimor kurok me mak?
faq.a: Eab. Eke kurok, mak, an wounen nane me erum. O bwiida ian ngago me ngago, me an bwiida ian ubun e magitet an erieri.

faq.q: Bwapepa aitsiu e arorong in emwidr?
faq.a: Amo kakar etokwog ekeking me eke cartoons, bwe bwapepa e omo ñan engame ririd. Etong tsi e mwir an kakar me eke arorong in emwidr.

faq.q: E maagur eij, me e magu a an tsiedida?
faq.a: Io, e maagur, me eke akaun, eke tsiedida me eke daunrood. E mwir ian web browser ian tepon, tablet me kompiuta.

conversation-cards.name: Kaat in dorer
conversation-cards.description: Bildkarten mit sanften Gesprächsanregungen für Familien, Freunde und ältere Menschen, auch für Menschen mit Demenz. Keine Abfragen, keine richtigen Antworten.
conversation-cards.short: Kaat in aitsiu me eke kuits. Katsimor dorer.
conversation-cards.intro: Aiquen kaat e torea aitsiu me katsimor dorer, bwe "Meda ebwa in ean ngago o gobweda?" Eke dorer me erum me eke memori. Aen tema me amwirida amuro.
howTo: Aen tema, me koro "Kaat amuro".
Aea dorer me aea aitsiu nanga.
Rongerong, katsimor dorer imwim, me koro dorer an mwir.
Tsinita "Kaat me ijei" ngago o gobweda, me o bwiida ian kaat ngago o gobweda.
Tsinita "Bwio kaat amuro" bwe o koto bwapepa.
tips: Doreda dorer imwim tsin. E arorong in dorer, me eke intabyu.
Koro dorer in aitsiu, me eke facts. E omo me details e wounen.
Me kaat e katsimor dorer in kakar, aea an arorong me ean kaat me ijei.

faq.q: Ekeita me eke dorer in "O nuwawida…"?
faq.a: Dorer ngago o kuits memori e arorong in eksam me e kakar. Katsimor dorer bwe "Katsimor dorer in…" e koro aiquen engame an dorer, ian ngago me ngago.

faq.q: A ngab bwio kaat?
faq.a: Io. "Bwio kaat amuro" e bwio kaat amuro ian reta etong, ebwak kaat ian aiquen bwapepa, bwe o koto.

faq.q: E maagur eij, me e magu a an tsiedida?
faq.a: E, e pumwe eab, me eke akaun, registe me eab iwiid. E mwitwen nane browser ate terepon, tabret me kompiuta.

photo-pairs.name: Pija me pairin
photo-pairs.seoTitle: Mwakani geim in pair pija ian pija ngen fämili
photo-pairs.description: Kadurow pija ngen fämili bwe geim in pair e maron me kamie. Kidä 2 ngari 6 pija nane dän ngam; e mimin ian browser ngam me eab upload nane ebwak.
photo-pairs.short: Kidä pija ngam me kadurow. Eke tsimurin e upload.
photo-pairs.intro: Wählen Sie zwei bis sechs eigene Familienfotos von Ihrem Handy, Tablet oder Computer, und daraus wird ein Memory-Spiel mit großen, gut sichtbaren Bildern. Die Fotos werden nur auf dieser Seite gezeigt. Sie werden nicht hochgeladen, nicht gespeichert und nicht weitergegeben, und sie verschwinden, sobald Sie die Seite schließen. Wenn Sie möchten, schreiben Sie ein paar Worte unter jedes Foto. Ein sanfter Hinweis kann nach einer kurzen Pause auf ein Paar zeigen. So können Sie sich gemeinsam Familienfotos ansehen.
howTo: Tippen Sie auf „Fotos auswählen“ und wählen Sie zwei bis sechs Fotos aus.
Jedes Foto erscheint zweimal. Tippen Sie auf eines und dann auf sein Gegenstück.
Wenn Sie möchten, schreiben Sie ein paar Worte unter jedes Foto. Die Beschriftungen werden nicht gespeichert.
Sprechen Sie über jedes Foto, wenn Sie es finden.
Wenn Sie fertig sind, schließen Sie die Seite oder tippen Sie auf „Fotos entfernen“. Nichts wird aufbewahrt.
tips: Kidä pija e katsin ngen kiki e oaten me kabori: pet, garden, te ebwak e oaten, me ran in kabubwiya.
Pija ngen te ebwak me kiki e maron e katsin ngen pija in ewa, me eab aijebur engame bwe ro nemin engame.
Dowa pija ngen engame ro ama ngage e bita atumor, aea e bita kamo ngage ro oaten.

faq.q: Pija ngak e upload nane ebwak?
faq.a: Eab. Tei peij e aea pija nane browser ngam me obo ate skrin ngam. Eab owara ngen awo me ebwak engame, me e gog ngage amuro kakat me reload peij.

faq.q: E tsimurin taima me sko?
faq.a: Eab. Eke taima, sko, count in mwitwen me eke luus. Amuro maron bwiok ate te taim e oaten, me bwiok ate dabora e katsin me mwitwen bwe amaro.

faq.q: Ang maron sev geim bwe ngen taim in mwin?
faq.a: Eab ian browser, bwe pija e praivet me eab sev. Ap in pumwe eab Creative Activities ngen iPhone me iPad maron sev kopii in pija nane dän ngam.

picture-bingo.name: Bingo in pija
picture-bingo.description: Kostenloses druckbares Bilder-Bingo für Familien, Seniorengruppen und Pflegeheime. Große Bilder mit Wörtern, 9 oder 16 Felder und ein großer Ansager auf dem Bildschirm.
picture-bingo.short: Kat in bingo in pija maron print me caller ate skrin ngen krup.
picture-bingo.intro: Bingo e katsin ngen pija, eke namba, bwe eke engame e bo bwe aea dorer e riek. Print kat e ibuk, me arowa caller ate skrin bwe obo pija e katsin ate TV, laptop me tabret.
howTo: Kidä 9 ngari 16 skwea ate kat me ian ewo engame ro mwitwen.
Tap "Print cards". Kat ewon e ibuk.
Kaara caller ate skrin e katsin. Tap "Next picture" bwe obo pija ewon me etan.
Engame ro tabwe pija e kadurow ate kat ngen koen, baten me maka.
Engame ewon ro amaro lain, ngari kat e bita, ro oaten. Eke luus ian geim tei: mwitwen ngang engame ewon ro bita lain.
tips: Arowa tokin e katsin ngen botor kap me checkers. Baten e riek e maron kabori ngen kiid.
Etan pija me dorer kiki ngen pija: "Bout in anio. Nga e ibwid ate bout?"
Teko engame ro kabori ngen aea arowa skrin, me kadurow amen aroweda ngen engame ro bo ia.
9 skwea e mwitwen ngen bita krup. Arowa 20 ngari 30 minit bwe mwitwen.

faq.q: Awo maron arowa picture bingo ian care home?
faq.a: Print kat ewon ngen engame ewon, arowa caller ate skrin e katsin, me etan pija e maron me kadok. Mwitwen ngang engame ewon ro bita lain, bwe eke engame e dowa.

faq.q: E pumwe eab ngen print?
faq.a: E. Print kat ewon amuro oaten, ewon taim, ngen engame ngam ngari krup.

faq.q: Engame maron mwitwen ngage eab aea dorer?
faq.a: E. Skwea ewon e pija e katsin, me etan e mimin ian eton ngen engame ro oaten aea dorer.

picnic-planner.name: Picknickplaner
picnic-planner.seoTitle: Picknickplaner: Bilder für einen Ausflug auswählen
picnic-planner.h1: Picknickplaner: Bilder auswählen und dann zuordnen
picnic-planner.description: Wählen Sie Bilder von Speisen und Aktivitäten für ein Picknick aus und spielen Sie danach eine sanfte Zuordnungsrunde damit. Nichts wird auf Zeit gemessen. Kostenlos zum Spielen und Drucken.
picnic-planner.short: Wählen Sie Bilder von Speisen und Ausflugsaktivitäten für ein Picknick aus und ordnen Sie sie zu.
picnic-planner.intro: Tippen Sie auf Bilder von Speisen und Dingen, die man unternehmen kann, damit sie in den Picknickkorb wandern. Der Korb fasst bis zu sechs Bilder. Ein Satz in Worten sagt, was im Korb liegt, zum Beispiel „Unser Picknick: Brot, Käse, Äpfel und ein Drachen.“ Tippen Sie dann auf „Wir spielen mit unserem Picknick“, und es startet eine sanfte Zuordnungsrunde mit den gewählten Bildern. Die Bilder bleiben sichtbar, und nichts wird auf Zeit gemessen, gewertet oder gespeichert. „Unsere Picknickliste drucken“ druckt eine Checkliste mit allem, was Sie gewählt haben, und einem Kästchen zum Abhaken für jeden Gegenstand.
howTo: Tippen Sie auf ein Bild von Essen oder einer Aktivität. Es wandert in den Korb.
Tippen Sie auf ein Bild im Korb, um es wieder herauszunehmen.
Wählen Sie mindestens zwei Dinge aus und tippen Sie dann auf „Wir spielen mit unserem Picknick“.
Tippen Sie auf zwei gleiche Bilder. Die Bilder bleiben sichtbar, Sie müssen sich also nichts merken.
Tippen Sie auf „Unsere Picknickliste drucken“, um eine Papier-Checkliste mitzunehmen.
tips: Fragen Sie die Menschen, mit denen Sie unterwegs sind, was sie mitbringen möchten, und wählen Sie die Bilder gemeinsam aus.
Sprechen Sie über jedes Bild, sobald es in den Korb kommt: „Erinnern Sie sich an den Drachen, den wir am Strand steigen ließen?“
Auf dem Papier sind die leeren Linien für alles Weitere, das Sie mitbringen möchten, oder für einen Namen.

faq.q: Gibt es einen Timer, eine Punktzahl oder einen Gewinner?
faq.a: Nein. Nichts wird auf Zeit gemessen oder gezählt, und niemand gewinnt. Die Zuordnungsrunde kennt keine Fehlversuche und keine Punkte.

faq.q: Ist das ein Essensplan?
faq.a: Nein. Es ist ein Bildplan für einen Ausflug, über den man sprechen und den man auf Papier mitnehmen kann. Es sagt nicht, was jemand essen soll.

faq.q: Werden die Bilder, die wir auswählen, gespeichert oder verschickt?
faq.a: Nein. Der Korb bleibt nur auf dieser Seite. Er wird nicht gespeichert, nicht hochgeladen und nicht verschickt, und er ist weg, sobald Sie die Seite schließen.

faq.q: Gibt es eine Papierversion?
faq.a: Ja. „Unsere Picknickliste drucken“ druckt eine Seite im Format A4 oder US Letter. Sie zeigt die gewählten Bilder mit je einem Kästchen zum Abhaken und leere Linien für alles Weitere.

faq.q: Ist es kostenlos, und muss ich mich anmelden?
faq.a: Ja, es ist kostenlos, und es gibt kein Konto, keine Anmeldung und kein Herunterladen. Es funktioniert im Webbrowser auf Handy, Tablet oder Computer.

scrapbook.name: Fotoalbum
scrapbook.seoTitle: Fotoalbum: Familienfotos gemeinsam Seite für Seite durchblättern
scrapbook.h1: Fotoalbum: Fotos und Beschriftungen hinzufügen und dann durch die Seiten blättern
scrapbook.description: Wählen Sie zwei bis zwölf eigene Familienfotos auf Ihrem Gerät aus und blättern Sie sie wie in einem Buch durch, mit ein paar Worten unter jedem Foto. Nichts wird hochgeladen. Kostenlos zum Drucken.
scrapbook.short: Blättern Sie gemeinsam durch Ihre eigenen Familienfotos, wie in einem Buch.
scrapbook.intro: Wählen Sie zwei bis zwölf eigene Fotos von diesem Gerät aus. Jedes Foto wird zu einer Seite eines Buches, groß genug zum Ansehen, mit optionalen Worten darunter. Blättern Sie mit den Schaltflächen oder den Pfeiltasten, und nutzen Sie „Gemeinsam ansehen“, um nebeneinander nur die Fotos und Worte zu betrachten. Ihre Fotos bleiben auf diesem Gerät. Sie werden nicht hochgeladen oder gespeichert, und das Buch ist weg, sobald Sie die Seite schließen. „Album drucken“ druckt auf jeder Seite ein Foto mit seinen Worten, versehen mit Seitenzahlen.
howTo: Tippen Sie auf „Fotos auswählen“ und wählen Sie zwei bis zwölf Fotos aus. Fragen Sie vorher nach, bevor Sie ein Foto von jemandem verwenden, der nicht selbst zustimmen kann.
Blättern Sie mit „Vorherige Seite“ und „Nächste Seite“ oder mit den Pfeiltasten Links und Rechts.
Schreiben Sie bei Bedarf ein paar Worte unter ein Foto. Mit „Früher einordnen“ oder „Später einordnen“ ändern Sie die Reihenfolge.
Tippen Sie auf „Gemeinsam ansehen“, um die Bearbeitungsfunktionen auszublenden und das Buch nebeneinander anzusehen.
Tippen Sie auf „Album drucken“ für eine Papierkopie oder auf „Buch leeren“, wenn Sie fertig sind. Nichts wird aufbewahrt.
tips: Ekeni ata ni nang ika ang ekareran: te ekokora, te ran, ka te eka ni ang. Kom ko ataatam ni kapun ngan jen ataatam ngaiena.
Ang ataa ni eka ko ekabwen ataatam, ka e nang ko abwen ni kaeni dibwe, ka oi eka dibwe kaine ni ang ngaiena.
Ni kakabwe, ataatam ni ekeni ni kanuo ekeni folder, ka kin eka mi ataatam ka notes ni mone ngaiena.

faq.q: E mone timer, score ka winner?
faq.a: Ikai. Ko nang ang ekeni timer, score ka ekaeran, ka ikai eka winner. Namba ni kae ko ekeni ataatam ngaiena ni nang ika kakae ko te book.

faq.q: E sae ataatam ka captions ni kakae, upload ka kin e kakae?
faq.a: Ikai. Ataatam ni kaeni kakae ni nang ngaiena ko page ni, ka ikai upload, store ka kin e kakae. Captions ni nang ko kaeni dibwe ni page ni ebwe tu. Ni kakabwe page ni, book ni nang ko kaiten.

faq.q: E sae print book ni?
faq.a: Ee. "Print the scrapbook" ebwe print ata 1 ka caption ni ngaiena, ka page numbers. Ko kairi A4 ka US Letter ni dialog ni print.

faq.q: E free ka e dikenang sign up?
faq.a: Ee, e free, ka ikai account, sign-up ka download. E kakae ni web browser ni phone, tablet ka computer.

collage-board.name: Collage board
collage-board.seoTitle: Collage Board: 2 ran ekabwe ataatam ni kinen turns
collage-board.h1: Collage Board: Ekabwe ataatam ni board 1, ni kinen turns
collage-board.description: 2 ran ekabwe ataatam ni cut-out ni board 1 ni nang. Kom ko cut-out, ka kin place ni wano. Ikai timer ka score. Free ni play ka print.
collage-board.short: Take turns placing pictures on one shared board.
collage-board.intro: 2 ran e kaen ni wano ni nang, ni mone board 1 ni 12 places ka tray ni 8 cut-out ataatam. Kom cut-out, ka kin empty place, ka ataa e ebwe kaen ni wano. Ekaa turn e ebwe kaeni ran ngaiena. Ataa ran ni nang e mone shape ngaiena, circle ke square, ni board e kakae ni ran eka ko ni ekabwe ataa, ikai ni kakae ni color. Ran eka mone ni pass, ka ko e kin kaeni dibwe ni ang 1 step. Ikai timer, score ka save. "Print the board" ebwe print board ni wano ka ataatam ni kin cut.
howTo: Kom cut-out ni tray. E kakae "Chosen" ngaiena ni mone e kairi.
Kom empty place ni board. Cut-out e ebwe kaen ni wano, ka turn e ebwe kaeni ran ngaiena.
Ran eka mone ni kom Pass ngaiena, ke "Take back the last piece" ni kaeni dibwe 1 step.
Tap "Another set of pictures" for a different tray. Pictures already on the board stay where they are.
Kom "Start again" ni kaeni board, ka "Put it back" ngaiena ni mone kaeni dibwe ni ang.
tips: Kakae ingoa ni ata ni ekabwe, ke "the teacup goes by the house". Ekeni kakae ko ekabwe ni kaen aine ni nang.
Ekaa 2 ran ni kinen turns ni kairi cut-out ka place, ni ran eka mone kinen tang.
On paper, cut out the eight pictures with an adult helping, then place them on the printed boxes.

faq.q: E mone timer, score ka winner?
faq.a: Ikai. Ko nang ang ekeni timer, score ka ekaeran, ka ikai winner. Board ni mone ataa ni place ni wano e full ngaiena.

faq.q: E sae ataatam ni kakabwe save ke send?
faq.a: Ikai. Board e kaeni page ni ngaiena. Ikai save, upload ka count, ka e kaiten ni kakabwe page ni.

faq.q: E ekaeran ngaiena ataatam ni ran ni wano?
faq.a: Ran ni nang e mone shape. Ataatam ni ran 1 e mone circle ni kon, ka ataatam ni ran 2 e mone square, ka ingoa ran ni nang e kaeni board.

faq.q: E mone version ni paper?
faq.a: Ee. "Print the board" ebwe print board ni wano ni 12 boxes, ka ataatam 8 ni tuku ni wano ni size ni ang, ka cutting line. Ran ni kaeni dibwe ebwe cut.

faq.q: E free ka e dikenang sign up?
faq.a: Ee, e free, ka ikai account, sign-up ka download. E kakae ni web browser ni phone, tablet ka computer.

garden-planner.name: Garden planner
garden-planner.seoTitle: Garden Planner: Ekeni plot ni ata ni plant
garden-planner.h1: Garden Planner: Kairi ataatam ka ekeni plot
garden-planner.description: Kairi ataatam ni plant ka ekokora ni garden, ka tuku ni 12 beds ni plot. Kom ata, ka kin bed. Ikai timer ka score. Free ni play ka print.
garden-planner.short: Kairi ataatam ni plant ka ekeni plot ni 12 beds.
garden-planner.players: Ran 1, ke 2 ran ni kaen ko
garden-planner.intro: Kairi ataatam ni tray ni plant ka ekokora ni garden, ka kom bed ni tuku ataa e mone. Plot e mone 12 beds, ka bed e mone ata 1. Summary ni kakae ko plan e mone, ni ekaeran, "Your plan has 3 sunflowers, 2 roses and 1 tree." Ikai timer, score ka save, ka ikai turns. E ataatam ni plan ni kakae, ikai advice ni plant. "Print the plan" ebwe print beds ni ataatam ni kairi, ka beds ni kaen ni draw ka lines ni notes.
howTo: Kom ata ni tray. E kakae "Chosen" ngaiena ni mone e kairi.
Kom bed. Ata e ebwe kaen ni wano, ka choice e ebwe tuku.
Ni kakabwe bed, kairi ata ni ang ka kom bed. Ni kakabwe bed, kom ni ikai ata e kairi.
Kom "Start again" ni kaeni beds ni wano, ka "Put it back" ni mone kaeni dibwe ni ang.
Kom "Print the plan" ni paper copy ni plot ka summary.
tips: Talk about each picture as it goes in, such as "the sunflower goes by the birdhouse". Talking makes it a shared activity.
Let each person choose a picture in turn, or choose the pictures together, so both have a say in the plot.
On paper, the blank beds are for drawing in your own ideas, and the notes lines are for anything you want to remember.

faq.q: Is this planting advice?
faq.a: No. This is a picture plan to talk about, not planting advice. It does not say when, where or how to plant anything, because that depends on where you live.

faq.q: Is there a timer, a score or a winner?
faq.a: No. Nothing is timed, scored, rated or counted, and nobody wins. A full plot gets no special message.

faq.q: Are the pictures we choose saved or sent?
faq.a: No. The plan stays on this page only. It is not saved, uploaded or counted, and it is gone when you close the page.

faq.q: Is there a paper version?
faq.a: Yes. "Print the plan" prints one page, on A4 or US Letter. It shows the twelve beds with the pictures you chose, the summary in words, and blank lines for notes.

faq.q: Is it free, and do I need to sign up?
faq.a: Yes, it is free, and there is no account, sign-up or download. It works in the web browser on a phone, tablet or computer.

coloring-wall.name: Group coloring wall
coloring-wall.seoTitle: Group Coloring Wall: One Picture for Many Hands
coloring-wall.h1: Group Coloring Wall: One Big Picture, Colored Together
coloring-wall.description: Print one large picture across several pages, so a family, a class or a care home can color one wall together. Free to print. No timer or score.
coloring-wall.short: Print one big picture across pages for many people to color.
coloring-wall.players: A group, at a table or on a wall
coloring-wall.intro: Choose a picture from the coloring pages and a wall of 4, 6 or 9 pages. Print the wall: the first page shows how to put it together, and each of the other pages is one part of the same big picture, with a label such as A1 in its corner. Each person colors one or more pages, in any colors and any style. The pages are then laid out by their labels and joined with tape on the back. Nothing is timed, scored or saved.
howTo: Choose a picture, then choose how many pages the wall has.
Read the map on the screen, which shows where each label goes.
Tap "Print the wall" and print all the pages.
Give each person one or more pages to color. Colors and styles do not need to match.
Lay the pages out by their labels, and join them with tape on the back.
tips: Give the pages with the simplest outlines to the people who want a quieter task, and the busier ones to anyone who enjoys them.
Hang the wall where everyone can see it, and talk about the parts together.
Choose a smaller wall for a small table, and a bigger one for a room.

faq.q: Is there a timer, a score or a winner?
faq.a: No. Nothing is timed, scored or counted, and nobody wins. The wall is simply a picture that many people colored.

faq.q: Are the pages saved or sent anywhere?
faq.a: No. The wall is made on this page only. It is not saved, uploaded or counted, and it is gone when you close the page.

faq.q: Do the colors have to match?
faq.a: No. Every person can use any colors and any style. The pages still join up into one picture.

faq.q: Is there a paper version?
faq.a: Yes. The printed wall is the whole game: a first page with the steps and a map, and one page for each part of the picture.

faq.q: Is it free, and do I need to sign up?
faq.a: Yes, it is free, and there is no account, sign-up or download. It works in the web browser on a phone, tablet or computer.

quiet-shapes.name: Quiet shapes puzzle
quiet-shapes.seoTitle: Quiet Shapes Puzzle: Fit Shapes Into a Picture
quiet-shapes.h1: Quiet Shapes Puzzle: Fit the Pieces into the Picture
quiet-shapes.description: Fit simple shapes into the outline of a house, a boat, a fish and more. Tap a piece, then a space of the same shape. There is no timer or score. Free to play and print.
quiet-shapes.short: Fit simple shapes into a picture, at your own pace.
quiet-shapes.intro: A picture outline, such as a house, a boat or a rocket, is divided into spaces. Each space has a piece of the same shape, a large or small triangle, a square, a parallelogram or a rectangle. Tap a piece, then tap a space of the same shape, and it fits. The space turns the piece for you, so there is nothing to drag or rotate. If a piece is a different shape from a space, it stays in the tray with a short note. Nothing is timed or scored, and nothing is saved or sent. "Print this shape" prints the outline and its pieces on one page to color or cut out.
howTo: Tap a piece in the tray. It shows "Chosen" while it is selected.
Tap a space in the picture. If the shape matches, the piece fits there.
If it does not match, try another space. Nothing is lost by trying.
Tap a piece in the picture to take it back to the tray, or use "Start again" to take all of them back.
When every space has its piece, the picture is complete. Tap "Another shape" for a new one, or tap Rest to stop.
tips: Turn on the hint lines to see each space. Turn them off for more of a puzzle, with only the outline to go by.
Start with the big shapes, such as the large triangles and the rectangles. The small pieces often go last.
Name the shapes out loud as you go: "a triangle, a square, a long rectangle". Talking can make it a shared activity.
On paper, colour the pieces with two or three colours, or cut them out with an adult helping.

faq.q: Is there a timer, a score or a move count?
faq.a: No. Nothing is timed, counted or scored. A piece that does not fit is simply not placed, and you can stop whenever you like.

faq.q: Is anything we make saved or sent?
faq.a: No. The picture stays on this page only. It is not saved, uploaded or counted, and it is gone when you close the page.

faq.q: Are the places big enough for a tremor or a small screen?
faq.a: The outline is drawn as large as the screen allows, and each space is a button you can reach with a finger or with the Tab key. The pieces in the tray are the large buttons of the page.

faq.q: Is there a paper version?
faq.a: Yes. "Print this shape" prints one picture on one page: the outline with its hint lines, and the pieces drawn at the same size beside it. Colour the pieces, or cut them out to fit. An adult can do the cutting.

faq.q: Is it free, and do I need to sign up?
faq.a: Yes, it is free, and there is no account, sign-up or download. It works in the web browser on a phone, tablet or computer.

calm-breathing.name: Eamwir e katsin
calm-breathing.seoTitle: A Calm Breathing Pause to Share
calm-breathing.description: Taim in eamwir e maron me katsin ngen share: sakor e tubwa me e riek ngen 6 eamwir. Amuro kaara, me amuro maron bwiok ate te taim amuro oaten.
calm-breathing.short: Sakor e maron ngen eamwir ian arowen. Kaara me bwiok ngage amuro oaten.
calm-breathing.intro: Taim ewon mwitwen e katsin e bwiok e maron. Tap "Start", me eamwir ian sakor e tubwa me eamwir eow ngage e riek. Kidä e maron ngari e katsin. Eke medesin, e taim in katsin ngen share.
howTo: Tekateki e katsin ian arowen me arowen.
Kidä taim: e maron ngari e katsin.
Tap "Start". Eamwir ian sakor e tubwa, me eamwir eow ngage e riek.
E bwiok ewon ngage 6 eamwir e bita, ngari tap "Stop" ate te taim amuro oaten.
tips: Kiid pein ngari dowa pei ate pae ngen amen ngam ngage e oaten.
Eke kae. Ngage ro oaten aea, e katsin.
Ngage engame e kabori ngen eamwir, eamwir ngen kiki me aea sakor. Dorer ngen dokta ngage e tsimurin kabori ngen eamwir.

faq.q: Tei e ekises in medesin ngen eamwir?
faq.a: Eab. E taim e maron ngen katsin me mimin ian arowen. Eke medesin ngen anxiety ngari te bita kabori. Dorer ngen dokta ngen kiki in bwiema.

faq.q: Sakor e mwitwen ngage ang eab kaara?
faq.a: Deõ. Eko imin nimwemwe ñaga eitsiõk wo tap Start, me e katoki mwurin 6 ònano eke ngaga wo tap Stop. Ña device om e set bwe e reduce motion, dorer nan tsientji me eab eba circle.

faq.q: E free ñe, me a bita sign up?
faq.a: Eh, e free, me eko account, sign-up eke download. E makur eat web browser eat phone, tablet eke computer.

story-chain.name: Story chain
story-chain.seoTitle: Story Chain: a Shared Picture Story Game
story-chain.h1: Story Chain: Tell a Story One Picture at a Time
story-chain.description: A row of pictures grows one at a time, and each person says a sentence about it aloud. Nothing to type, no right answer. Free, calm, no timer and no score.
story-chain.short: Add a picture, then say a sentence each, taking turns.
story-chain.intro: The game starts with one picture and grows the chain one picture at a time. Each person says one sentence about the chain so far, out loud, in turn. A sentence can be about what you see, a place it brings to mind, or something silly. Nothing is typed, recorded or kept, there is no right answer, and anyone may pass. The chain stops at eight pictures, and then you can start a new one.
howTo: Look at the first picture together.
Take turns: each person says one sentence about the chain so far. Anyone may pass.
Tap "Add a picture" to put the next picture at the end of the chain.
Tap "Take the last one off" if you would rather go back a picture.
When the chain has eight pictures, tap "Start a new chain" for a fresh one, or simply stop.
tips: Short is fine: "Someone put the kettle on." The next person carries on, or passes.
Let the pictures lead. There is no story you are meant to arrive at.
Stop whenever you like. Stopping halfway is a perfectly good way to finish.

faq.q: Is there a timer or a score?
faq.a: No. There is no clock, score, move counter or losing. You can stop at any moment, and stopping halfway is a perfectly good way to finish.

faq.q: Is anything typed or recorded?
faq.a: No. The sentences are spoken aloud and are not typed, recorded or sent anywhere. The game only shows the pictures.

faq.q: What if someone does not want to say anything?
faq.a: Anyone may pass, and the next person goes on. Nobody has to name or remember a picture.

faq.q: Is it free, and do I need to sign up?
faq.a: Yes, it is free, and there is no account, sign-up or download. It works in the web browser on a phone, tablet or computer.

quiet-scene.name: Quiet scene
quiet-scene.seoTitle: Quiet Scene: One Picture at a Time
quiet-scene.h1: Quiet Scene: One Still Picture at a Time
quiet-scene.description: One large, still picture at a time, each with one gentle line under it. Press Next or Previous when you are ready. Nothing moves or plays on its own, and there is no timer or score. Free to play, with no account.
quiet-scene.short: Look at one still picture at a time, at your own pace.
quiet-scene.players: Alone, or a group in the same room
quiet-scene.intro: One large picture fills the screen, with one short line under it. Press "Next picture" or "Previous picture" when you are ready for another. Nothing moves, fades or changes on its own, and nothing is timed. Tap "Bigger picture" to show only the picture, so the whole room can see it on a television.
howTo: Look at the picture together.
Read the line under it aloud if you like.
Press "Next picture" or "Previous picture" when you are ready.
Tap "Bigger picture" to show only the picture, and "Show everything" to bring the rest back.
Stop whenever you like with "Done for now".
tips: Let the person choose when to move on: wait for them to look, then press Next.
For a group, use "Bigger picture" on a television or large screen and sit where everyone can see it.
There is no right way to look at a picture. Simply talking about one is a complete activity.

faq.q: Is there a timer or a score?
faq.a: No. There is no clock, score, move counter or losing. You can stop at any moment, and stopping halfway is a perfectly good way to finish.

faq.q: Does it play sound or move?
faq.a: No. There is no sound, and nothing moves, fades or changes by itself. A picture changes only when you press a button.

faq.q: Gibe ena paper version?
faq.a: Ikai. Ena ekakairũ ni dimwa ni kaiakuma ni mwaneeni ibukin ekiten ko ekiten. Ena totoo ko bata ene eman ko kiropu are kakiinin ekeke e ng-kingi ni kakaokano ibukin, e tumai ko kakiinin tibu.

faq.q: Ena ekeke ni wa ko ng-kakaokano ni kinan, ko e ng-kiaroku?
faq.a: Ee, ena ekeke ni wa, ao ena ekaunti, ena kakiroku, ao ena e ng-kabutin. E aki ng-kakaokano ibukin uiuia ko kaakea ni te web browser i te telefon, te tablet ao te komputa.

color-wash.name: Color wash
color-wash.seoTitle: Color Wash: Kaakea ni Kaa Mwakuri ibukin Te Ekiten
color-wash.h1: Color Wash: Te Kakai ni Kaa Mwakuri ni Ekiten
color-wash.description: Te bush ni bobon e kakai kaa wide ao kaa ni kangaan, ni kaa maan kaa ao rua kakaaan bush. E aki ko te nako, e aki te manuia ao te taim. Ekeke ni wa ni ng-kaakaokano, e aki ekaunti.
color-wash.short: Kakai kaa mwakuri ni ekiten, ni kabwaitoro ko kaunikai.
color-wash.players: Ataei, ao 2 ang te tangiraoi ni tiribakuria
color-wash.intro: Ekiten ao maan bush ni bobon. Kaotemwa kaa ao kaakaan bush, ao kakai ni ekeke ibukin kakai te kaa mwakuri ni ekiten. E aki te nako ni ekiten: e aki ana ko kakaoti, e aki ana mwakuri ni kairo, ao e aki te manuia. Kakai mwakuri aomata ni kaua, ao ko e ng-kanakoi ni tuiu te bush ao kakiinin. Te ekiten ni kakoi e kakaokaa ana ko te kaubwai, ao te "Kangai ni kabutu" e kakaokai ana ni tuatuke.
howTo: Kaotemwa kaa. Kaa aika kaa a ana ing ni wiwi.
Kaotemwa Wide ke Very wide. Very wide e kakai ekiten bwa ni kakai aika ni kabono.
Kakai ni mwakuri me ko ni kangai, mouse ke pen ni kakai kaa mwakuri ni ekiten.
Ke ko ng-kakaokano ni kabwaitoro arrow ibukin kakaokano bush ring, ao Space ibukin kaneta bush ke kaiu.
Ko e ng-kanakoi "A fresh page" ibukin kakabutu ekiten, ao "Put it back" ngkoe ko kakiinin ana kaa mwakuri.
tips: Tangiraoi e kaotemwa kaa ibukin kakai mwakuri ae mai, ao kakaokano ana kaa are ke kakai.
Very wide e ngaa ni kakaokano bwa e aki kakaoti ibukin bush, bwa e aki ana ko kakakona ana bush.
E aki ana bwai bwa ko mwakuri aomata ni kaokaa. Ko e ng-kaiu ni kangai, ke ko e kaaki "Done for now".

faq.q: Ena kakaoti, manuia ke taim?
faq.a: Ikai. E aki ana nako ni ekiten. E aki ana bwai ni kakaoti, kakaoa, ekaunti ke kakaokano manuia, ao e aki ana kakaaki ni kakaoti.

faq.q: A ekiten ni kakiinin ke kakai?
faq.a: Ikai. E aki kakiinin, kakaoa ke kakai. Kaa mwakuri e tu ni ekiten ni kangai ni kaiu.

faq.q: Ko e ng-kakaokano ni kabwaitoro mouse ke touch screen?
faq.a: Ee. Ke ekiten e kakiri ana, ao arrow keys e kakaokano bush ring, ao Space e kaneta bush ni kaiu ke ni kabwaitoro. Screen e kakaaki "Brush down" ke "Brush up" ni kangai.

faq.q: Ena paper version?
faq.a: Ikai. Watercolor ni paper e bwai ae tiku, bush ae kaubwai ao kaa ae tokin ni kangai, ngkoe e bwai ae kakaokano ni mwakuri ni kakai ni te teiburu.

faq.q: Kaa ana ngke?
faq.a: Yellow, orange, green ao purple, kaa ni ma ana kaa ni mwakuri ni ekiten ao ni kakaiu ni kaobwai. Kangai kaa a ana ing ni wiwi, ao ing ana e kakaaki te kaotemwa.

faq.q: Ena ekeke ni wa ko ng-kakaokano ni kinan, ko e ng-kiaroku?
faq.a: Ee, ena ekeke ni wa, ao ena ekaunti, ena kakiroku, ao ena e ng-kabutin. E aki ng-kakaokano ibukin uiuia ko kaakea ni te web browser i te telefon, te tablet ao te komputa.
